cohort: A retrospective cohort of 1,352 mothers with singleton pregnancies who presented for antenatal checkups from 20 weeks or earlier in a secondary care hospital in South India.
finding: Overweight/obese pregnant women showed increased odds of developing gestational diabetes mellitus and undergoing a cesarean section, while poor gestational weight gain was associated with low birth weight and excess weight gain with pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Overweight/obese pregnant women had 1.6 times higher odds of undergoing a cesarean section compared to pregnant women with normal BMI.
